Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
FADE IN:

INT. RECORDS OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and dignitaries. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is presented with a certificate and a plaque, and the room erupts in applause.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, It Is Our Pleasure To Present The World Record For Oldest Human To Ever Live To The One And Only JASPER JENKINS!

Jasper Smiles, Tears Welling Up In His Eyes, As He Accepts The Award.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jasper Lies In Bed, The Certificate And Plaque Displayed On His Nightstand. He Looks Up At The Ceiling, A Faraway Look In His Eyes.

JASPER (V.O)
I Remember Reading About This Theory When I Was Young. Quantum Immortality. The Idea That Every Time A Person Dies, The Universe Creates A New Branch, A New Reality, Where They Survived.

Jasper's Voice Becomes More Urgent, More Desperate.

JASPER (V.O)
I Always Thought It Was Just A Theory. A Crazy Idea. But Now... Now I'm Not So Sure.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S MIND - NIGHT

Jasper's Mind Becomes A Jumbled Mess Of Images And Thoughts. He Sees Himself Dying, Repeatedly, Over And Over Again. He Sees The Universe Branching Out, Creating New Realities, New Jaspers.

JASPER (V.O)
What If I'm Not Alone? What If There Are Millions Of Me, Living Out Different Lives, In Different Realities?

Jasper's Voice Becomes A Scream, Echoing Through His Mind.

JASPER (V.O)
I'M NOT ALONE! I'M NOT ALONE!

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jasper Sits Up In Bed, His Eyes Wide With Fear. He Looks Around The Room, As If Searching For Something.

JASPER (V.O)
I Have To Find Them. I Have To Know The Truth.

Jasper Throws Off The Covers, And Gets Out Of Bed. He Stumbles To The Window, And Looks Out Into The Night.

JASPER (V.O)
I'll Find Them. I'll Find The Other Me's. And I'll Know The Truth.

FADE TO BLACK.

FADE IN:

EXT. JASPER'S HOUSE - NIGHT

Jasper Stands In The Front Yard, Looking Up At The Stars. He Takes A Deep Breath, And Begins To Walk Away From The House.

JASPER (V.O)
I'll Follow The Branches. I'll Follow The Universe.

Jasper Disappears Into The Night, Leaving Behind A Trail Of Questions And Uncertainty.

FADE TO BLACK.
